SURREAL_USER.description: Half of the login. SurrealDB publishes a full table of these names, which is rarer than it should be.

SURREAL_TOKEN.description: A JWT used instead of the pair. SurrealDB says to treat it as a credential because it grants whatever the authenticating user does, and to keep it out of shell history and committed scripts.

SURREAL_NAMESPACE.description: Which namespace to select. A name.

SURREAL_DATABASE.description: Which database within it. A name.

SURREAL_AUTH_LEVEL.description: Root, namespace or database. SurrealDB keeps control-plane credentials under a separate SURREALCTL_ prefix, so a database token cannot be sent to the cloud API by accident.
